If yes, JSON: {"conflict": true, "old_chunk": <id number of the OLD passage>, "topic": str, "current_rule": str, "old_rule": str, "current_facts": [1-3 word-for-word spans from CURRENT], "old_fact": a word-for-word span from the OLD passage with the old rule, "questions": [2 differently worded questions a policyholder would ask about this rule today]}.
